notes: Post-count data for Instagram hashtags is not reliably or completely verifiable at scale: Instagram does not publish an official API for exact per-hashtag post totals, and third-party hashtag-analytics sites frequently disagree with each other by wide margins (sometimes 100x) and go stale quickly. Where multiple independent sources roughly converge on an order of magnitude for a very well-known tag, that figure is included with countType 'approximate' and a source note. For the large majority of hashtags in this dataset, postCount is honestly set to null (countType 'unknown') rather than inventing a precise-looking number. Treat all non-null counts here as rough, dated estimates to be refreshed periodically, not as verified Instagram figures.
